test_title: PYST 01: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 05 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which Article of the Directive Principles of State Policy was added by the 97th Constitutional Amendment Act of the Constitution of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 43 B**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Article 43 B** was added to the Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP) by the **97th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2011**.
 
• This Article aims to **promote voluntary formation, autonomous functioning, democratic control, and professional management of cooperative societies**.
 
• The 97th Constitutional Amendment Act recognizes **cooperatives** as an important economic vehicle for inclusive growth.
 
• It inserts the word **"cooperatives"** in Article 19(1)(c), ensuring the right to form cooperative societies as a fundamental right.
 
• Additionally, Article 43 B in Part IV of the Constitution emphasizes the state's role in promoting cooperatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **97th Constitutional Amendment Act:**

 
 
• It came into effect on **15 February 2012**.
 
• The amendment added **"cooperative societies"** to the Constitution, recognizing their significance in economic development.
 
• It made provisions for the **protection and regulation of cooperative societies** under state law.
 
 
 
• **Directive Principles of State Policy:**
 
 
• These principles are enshrined in Part IV of the Indian Constitution.
 
• They are non-justiciable but serve as guidelines for the government in policy-making.
 
• The DPSPs aim to establish a welfare state, ensuring socio-economic justice.
 
 
 
• **Cooperative Societies:**
 
 
• Cooperatives are **autonomous associations** of persons united voluntarily to meet their common economic, social, and cultural needs.
 
• They are based on principles such as **democratic control and equitable distribution of resources**.
 
• In India, cooperatives play a crucial role in sectors like agriculture, banking, and housing.
 
 
 
• **Part IV of the Constitution:**
 
 
• Part IV of the Constitution deals with **Directive Principles of State Policy**.
 
• It includes Articles 36 to 51, focusing on principles to be followed by the state to ensure the welfare of citizens.
 
• Articles such as 38, 39, 41, and 43 highlight socio-economic goals like equal pay, living wages, and right to work.
